description: A project's terms: each word, its other spellings, its short definition, its kind, and its source (a wiki page or an issue, with the heading on it). 'state' is 'confirmed' (shown to readers, marked in texts), 'proposed' (found on a page by its markup or by the model, waiting for a person — set_term with state 'confirmed' or 'rejected' decides it) or 'rejected' (kept so it is not offered again). Proposed and rejected ones are listed only to members who may write. Only terms whose source you may open. 'uses' is how many times the project's pages and issues use the term by any spelling (null: not counted yet); the most used come first, a page at a time — 'total' says how many there are. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

kind.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated — 'статус,система'; an empty one ('статус,') also takes terms with no kind. 'kinds' in the answer says which there are.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 200. Default 100.

offset.description: How many to skip — for the next page.

state.description: 'confirmed', 'proposed', 'rejected' or leave out for all you may see.

name: list_terms
